verdict.rationale: Column is a pure HTTP API (no GUI required) with a full-featured sandbox that persists data 'exactly like production' and supports simulated transfers, plus OpenAPI-based SDK generation and idempotency-key support for safe automated retries — all of which enable scripted/CI-driven testing and automation. However, there is no explicit CI/CD documentation, no CLI tool, and no first-party example of running Column in an automated pipeline (their own engineer notes they only expose HTTP APIs, not tooling like a CLI). Missing for 10: dedicated CI/automation guide, official CLI or headless test harness, and independent confirmation of CI usage.
